question: In November 2024, which Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT) unveiled a Mechanical Knee Rehabilitation Device, which is a mechanical Completely Mechanical Passive (CPM) machine unlike traditional motorised CPM machines, eliminating the need for electricity, batteries and motors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Ropar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **IIT Ropar** unveiled a Mechanical Knee Rehabilitation Device in November 2024.
 
• This device is a **Completely Mechanical Passive (CPM) machine**, unlike traditional motorized CPM machines.
 
• The device **eliminates the need for electricity, batteries, and motors**.
 
• It is designed to assist in knee rehabilitation without any external power source.
 
• The innovation aims to be **cost-effective** and accessible for patients in remote and resource-limited settings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Completely Mechanical Passive (CPM) Machine:**

 
 
• CPM machines are used in physical therapy to help patients recover range of motion in their joints post-surgery.
 
• Traditional CPM machines are motorized and require a power source.
 
 
 
• **Knee Rehabilitation:**
 
 
• Knee rehabilitation is crucial for recovery post-injury or surgery to restore function and reduce pain.
 
• Exercises and mechanical devices are often used to assist in the rehabilitation process.
 
 
 
• **IIT Ropar:**
 
 
• Indian Institute of Technology Ropar is a premier engineering and technology institute in India.
 
• It is known for its innovative research and contributions to various fields of science and technology.
 
 
 
• **Accessibility in Medical Devices:**
 
 
• Creating medical devices that do not rely on electricity can significantly benefit rural and underdeveloped areas.
 
• Such innovations ensure that essential medical care is accessible to a broader population.
